scope: MergeLock paper implementation: frozen sampler, no images or tuning. All seven Table1A tasks and all outcomes retained.
repository_status: Checked 2026-11-13: README only, Coming Soon; not an official implementation.

implementation_choices.sampler: Paper Sec.3.4 specifies A=RPD but not the distribution/range/seed. Standard-normal R, uniform permutation, uniform diagonal [.05,20], seed0 are explicit adaptation choices. Diagonal range matches our existing PaRaMS comparator. No condition-based resampling.
implementation_choices.precision: Matrix construction/inversion and products in float64, saved in original checkpoint dtype.
implementation_choices.transpose_convention: Use the bilinear identities Eq.8-9: row features QA,KA^{-T},VB, and inverse output compensation. PyTorch weight and column-bias storage use explicit transposes.
implementation_choices.comparison: Do not label these numbers official or exact-author reproduction. Evaluate standalone utility before interpreting merged accuracy.
